items.title: Pay invoice for electrical work
items.quote: Zahlbar innerhalb von 14 Tagen nach Rechnungsdatum ohne Abzug.
items.computation: Period starts from the invoice date (Rechnungsdatum) 20.03.2026. Under §187 Abs.1 BGB, the day of the triggering event is not counted, so counting begins 21.03.2026. A 14-day period from 20.03.2026 ends on 03.04.2026 (Friday). Check for holidays/weekends at the payer's location (NW), per §§269, 270 Abs.4 BGB for payments to a company: 03.04.2026 is Good Friday (nationwide holiday) → excluded. Under §193 BGB, if the last day is a Sunday, general holiday, or a Saturday, it moves to the next working day; the following days are: 04.04.2026 (Saturday, itself an excluded day under the explicit Saturday clause of §193 BGB), 05.04.2026 (Sunday, and also Easter Sunday), 06.04.2026 (Easter Monday, nationwide holiday). The next day that is not a Sunday, Saturday, or holiday is Tuesday 07.04.2026, which becomes the due date.
